scope: Exact relevant statement leaves with applicability limits, not full-paper referee audits

leaves.statement: For every epsilon there is a constant C_epsilon such that max(|a|,|b|,|c|)<=C_epsilon rad(abc)^(1+epsilon), uniformly in the triple.
leaves.application_limits: Target conjecture; source does not prove it.

leaves.statement: There is an effectively computable absolute C>0 such that c<exp(C R^(1/3)(log R)^3).
leaves.application_limits: Established unconditional benchmark; not certified latest optimal bound.

leaves.location: Mason theorem and proof, printed p. 94
hypotheses: A,B,C nonzero pairwise coprime in k[x]
leaves.statement: deg C<=n_0(ABC)-1; permutations give max-degree form.
leaves.application_limits: Characteristic-zero nonconstant condition valid. Positive characteristic derivative condition essential. No integer implication.

leaves.location: §3 Conjecture 4 and equivalence following, printed pp. 169–170
hypotheses: global minimal integral Weierstrass invariants c4,c6
leaves.statement: For every epsilon there is C_epsilon with max(|c4|^3,c6^2)<=C_epsilon N^(6+epsilon). Source states equivalence with full ABC, also upon restricting to semistable curves.
leaves.application_limits: Do not replace maximum-invariant form by ordinary discriminant bound.

hypotheses: number-field smooth variety/divisor/height data as in source
leaves.statement: Theorem 3.1: Conjecture 2.1 implies truncated-counting Conjecture 2.3. The rational three-point P1 case is ABC.
leaves.application_limits: An implication from a conjectural premise, not an unconditional result.

hypotheses: psi in T(a,b), so derivative additive on this triple
leaves.statement: c/log c <= rad(abc) ||psi||/log 2.
leaves.application_limits: Requires independent Wronskian and an appropriate small-norm estimate; additivity alone insufficient.

hypotheses: exclude triples (1,N,q) with q prime up to permutation
leaves.statement: There exists one eta in (0,1) such that admissible nonexceptional triples admit an independent psi with norm<c^eta.
leaves.application_limits: One eta is not every epsilon. This is a conjecture.

hypotheses: ABC, or the exact weak-exponent premise of Theorem 4.5
leaves.statement: ABC implies Small Derivatives. Small Derivatives implies a weak Oesterlé estimate c<rad(abc)^M for some M with finitely many exceptions. For 1<M<2, Theorem 4.5 gives derivatives for eta>1-(2-M)/(4M).
leaves.application_limits: Do not claim the single-eta conjecture equivalent to full epsilon-uniform ABC.

leaves.location: Theorem A, author p. 3 / Corollary 2.3, author pp. 54–55
hypotheses: X smooth proper geometrically connected curve over a number field
fixed positive integer degree bound d
leaves.statement: h_(omega_X(D))(P)<=(1+epsilon)(log-diff_X(P)+log-cond_D(P))+O_(X,D,d,epsilon)(1) on points of degree<=d in source-normalized notation.
leaves.application_limits: Published proof claim authenticated; proof not independently checked; ABC specialization not treated as established project input.

leaves.location: Theorem 3.11 starts author p. 153; Corollary 3.12 author pp. 173–174
hypotheses: initial Theta-data of IUT I Definition 3.1
distinct Hodge theaters in an LGP-Gaussian log-theta lattice
Theta holomorphic hull of union of possible pilot images subject to Ind1,Ind2,Ind3
leaves.statement: Corollary 3.12 asserts finite -|log(Theta)|>=-|log(q)|.
leaves.application_limits: Generic monotone-order certificate not original source instantiation. Full arithmetic object/normalization/observable/witness map remains required.

hypotheses: q-pilot construction and anabelian construction in common target
leaves.statement: The report has not reconstructed eta^q=eta_S^anab and withholds final verdict; noncommuting SS hexagon alone is not taken to establish defect in intended same-side comparison.
leaves.application_limits: Does not certify IUT and does not conclusively ratify SS rejection.

leaves.consulted_version: Author final PDF with provisional publication header
leaves.statement: Every elliptic curve E/Q is modular.
leaves.application_limits: Does not bound modular degree, congruence module, or construct prime-contact realization.

hypotheses: surjection phi from X_Gamma to E
leaves.statement: For X1(N), c_phi divides deg(phi). For intermediate Gamma, c_phi divides 6 deg(phi), and c_phi divides deg(phi) when N cube-free; further exact 2/3 refinements in source.
leaves.application_limits: Not a general theorem c_phi=1. Keep coefficient unless specialized hypotheses separately justified.

hypotheses: newform f and its source modular/congruence numbers
every maximal ideal of residue characteristic p containing I_f satisfies multiplicity one
leaves.statement: ord_p(n_Af)=ord_p(r_Af^2).
leaves.application_limits: Modular number and congruence number differ from their exponents; multiplicity hypothesis essential.

hypotheses: R,T complete Noetherian local O-algebras with residue field k
surjective local map R to T
leaves.statement: |O/eta_T|<=|Phi_R|; equality is equivalent to R,T complete intersections and the map an isomorphism.
leaves.application_limits: Contextual restatement attributed to Wiles/Lenstra. Toy ring not automatically actual arithmetic deformation input.

hypotheses: Steinberg at Q, finite flat at p, minimal elsewhere prescribed deformation problem
leaves.statement: Ring and Hecke module Wiles defects equal sum_(q|Q)2n_q/e, with n_q largest scalar-unramified congruence exponent and e coefficient ramification index.
leaves.application_limits: Specific global/deformation hypotheses essential. Does not realize project toy defect or prove ABC.

hypotheses: stated individual and product character nontriviality
leaves.statement: Gauss/Jacobi product relations lift to isomorphisms of invertible Chow motives; Jacobi sum endomorphism agrees with Frobenius.
leaves.application_limits: Characteristic-zero coefficients, not bounded integral realization. Some later generation assertions conditional.

hypotheses: kappa arbitrary field containing all dth roots
leaves.statement: Fermat motive indexed by (alpha,...,alpha), with twist n, is isomorphic to tensor product of the (alpha,chi) Fermat motives over nontrivial n-torsion characters chi.
leaves.application_limits: This relation is not confined to finite fields, but still does not supply integral norm/coherence and height bound.

leaves.location: Proposition 12.2 and final field-extension remark, printed p. 271
hypotheses: number field k with r1 real and r2 complex places
order o in central division algebra over k
leaves.statement: dim(K_i(o) tensor R)=0,r1+r2,0,r2 for i congruent 0,1,2,3 modulo4; statement extends to k. Hence K3(Q) rational rank0, K5(Q) rank1.
leaves.application_limits: Pure rational K/regulator context only; no vanishing assertion for all complex dilogarithms or mixed weight2 expressions.

leaves.statement: Li_s(z)=sum_(n>=1) z^n/n^s, analytic in disk; boundary series converges for Re(s)>1. Derivative z dLi_s/dz=Li_(s-1) follows termwise inside disk.
leaves.application_limits: Continuation and cuts require explicit choices. Original local download unavailable; official web source checked.
No branch-free identity across the cut.
Used with DLMF25.12.13 only in safe negative-real integer-order specialization.

hypotheses: E/Q_q split multiplicative with Tate parameter q_E
entire local Galois action on E[ell^n] scalar
leaves.source_statement: Tate-module sequence 0→Zell(1)→Tell(Eq)→Zell→0; extension Kummer class q; inertia off-diagonal image ell^r Zell, ell^r maximal power dividing v(q).
leaves.derived_manuscript_statement: Scalar full local action implies ell^n divides both q−1 and v_q(q_E); n<=min(vell(q−1),vell(vq(q_E))).
application_limits: Frobenius scalarity alone insufficient for inertia bound.
Residue cardinality/valuation must be adjusted over general local fields.

leaves.location: ChapterII §1 Introduction (b), first chapter page; publisher abstract corroborates
leaves.statement: End_K(A) tensor Zell→End_GK(Tell(A)) is an isomorphism. Tensoring gives End_GK(Vell(A))=End_K(A) tensor Qell.
application_limits: Scalar algebra requires End_K(A)=Z in elliptic case.
Number-field theorem due to Faltings, not Tate finite-field theorem.

leaves.location: README opening, Honesty boundary, Corollary3.12 variant strand
leaves.statement: Repository says it does not verify IUT; variant Corollary312 is deliberately unproved; implications to ABC are conditional and variant is distinguished from original corollary.
application_limits: Not a statement of universal community acceptance.
